The '''Tiragga system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mieru'kar sector/Legends|Mieru'kar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tiragga]].
